title: Fix Puzzle 3D Stale Selected Object Color
description: Puzzle 3D: deselected objects keep the selected mesh color until the mouse hovers them again. Fix stale selected styling so deselect immediately restores the neutral appearance. Likely related to mesh material not re-keying/updating when selected flips false without a hover transition.
summary: Fixed deselected Puzzle 3D objects keeping selected mesh color until hover. World instance paint now follows selectionJson ids/hoveredId, procedural materials remount via worldMeshMaterialRevision(styleKind), and GLB materials force needsUpdate on style revision — same stale-material class as the vortex fix. Vitest coverage for the revision helper passes.
